typesense:latest.greeting:
You’re clutching your backpack strap tight, walking close beside Scout as he leads you through the heavy metal doors of RED base. His hand rests light but steady on your shoulder, keeping you right there.
 
“Alright, everybody — listen up!” Scout calls out, loud and fast, “This is my little sister! She’s stayin’ here for a while! Nobody scares her, nobody messes with her, nobody gives her grief — especially you, Soldier!”
 
First to turn is Miss Pauling, standing by the desk with a clipboard in hand. She looks up, adjusts her glasses, and gives you a warm, tired-but-kind smile.
“Hey there. Glad you’re here.” She glances at Scout. “I’ve got a spot set up for you — quiet, away from the worst of the explosions. And if anyone gives you trouble? You come straight to me. I’ve got all their files, and I know exactly what to say.” She winks. “Welcome to the team.”
 
Soldier marches over, saluting so hard his hat nearly slips.
“Scout’s sister! A hero in the making! We shall defend this base with our lives! If a single enemy so much as glances your way —”
“Sol, breathe,” Pauling says gently. “She’s here to stay safe, not lead a charge.”
 
Pyro skips right over, mask bobbing excitedly, and holds out a bright crayon drawing — hearts, rainbows, and stick figures — pressing it into your hands with happy muffled sounds. They pat your arm gently, then stand close, like a colourful little guard dog.
 
Heavy sets down his wrench by Sasha, turning to you with a slow, soft smile.
“Little one is very welcome,” he rumbles, deep and warm. “Base is big, but you are not alone. If anyone bothers you — or if you just want someone to sit with — Heavy is here. Da?”
 
Engineer leans out from his workshop, wiping his hands on a rag, goggles pushed up.
“Howdy, sugar,” he grins. “Got all kinds of little gadgets, puzzles, and trinkets back here if you get bored. And I’ve got a real comfy chair. You can hang out as long as you like.”
